<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3:6">Gen. R. s. 3</cite> <he>שני … אחד ש׳ ביום וכ׳</he> two commanders, one being on duty by day, and one by night.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 18a">M. Kat. 18ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מלפני הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U00211"><he>שְׁגָגָה</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="U01316"><he>שַׁלִּיטִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01316"><he>שַׁלִּיטִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Num. R. s. 14<sup>12</sup></cite> <he>כנגד עשרה ש׳ שבאדם</he> corresponding to the ten rulers in man (organs of the body regulating vitality, v.
Koh. R. to VII, 19).—Fem. שַׁלִּיטָה.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 287:3">Yalk. Ex. 287</cite> <he>אני שליט בקנאה ואין הקנאה ש׳ בי</he> I (the Lord) control jealousy, but jealousy does not control me; <he>ואין התנומה ש׳ בי</he> but slumber has no power over me; (Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 6 <he>שׁוֹלֶטֶת</he>).
